subject.title: feat: sign stored OpenClaw catalog publications

question: Should the existing public plugin-feed route become fail-closed and envelope-only once the atomic secret and matching OpenClaw trust root have been staged and proven?
rationale: This changes an established public representation and makes endpoint availability depend on coordinated secret and consumer trust deployment; tests cannot decide the acceptable rollout order.

options.title: Stage and prove the coordinated rollout
options.body: Provision the atomic signer, confirm the matching OpenClaw keyId/public key, and require live verification and failure-path evidence before merging.

options.title: Preserve compatibility during rollout
options.body: Keep the unsigned representation or introduce a separately versioned signed route until signed consumers and trust roots are deployed.

options.title: Accept an availability window
options.body: Merge the fail-closed route before coordinated proof and explicitly accept temporary 503 or unverifiable-feed behavior during deployment.

recommendation.title: Stage and prove the coordinated rollout
recommendation.body: Provision the atomic signer, confirm the matching OpenClaw keyId/public key, and require live verification and failure-path evidence before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed the exact signing, rotation, and cache contract and are the clearest available owner for the remaining rollout decision.
